name: gradient
label: Gradient
css: .style-gradient { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF) 0%, rgba(153, 15, 250, 0.08) 100%); position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 64px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; } .style-gradient::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -40%; right: -40%; width: 800px; height: 800px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(153, 15, 250, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%); border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .style-gradient::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -30%; left: -30%; width: 600px; height: 600px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(230, 0, 118, 0.12) 0%, transparent 70%); border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .style-gradient .hook { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); letter-spacing: -0.02em; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-text, #111827) 0%, var(--slide-primary, #990FFA) 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; } .style-gradient .text { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 85%; margin-top: 24px; opacity: 0.9; } .style-gradient .step { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; position: absolute; top: 40px; right: 40px; color: var(--slide-primary, #990FFA); opacity: 0.12; z-index: 1; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .style-gradient .brand { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #990FFA); position: relative; z-index: 2; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .slide-code.style-gradient { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 100%); } .slide-code.style-gradient .hook { color: #FFFFFF; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFFFF 0%, var(--slide-primary, #990FFA) 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; } .slide-code.style-gradient .text { color: #e5e7eb; } .slide-code.style-gradient .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #990FFA); opacity: 0.2; } .slide-code.style-gradient .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #990FFA); } .slide-code.style-gradient::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(153, 15, 250, 0.2) 0%, transparent 70%); } .slide-code.style-gradient::after { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(230, 0, 118, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%); } .slide-insight.style-gradient { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 100%); } .slide-insight.style-gradient .hook { color: #FFFFFF; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #60a5fa 0%, var(--slide-primary, #990FFA) 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; } .slide-insight.style-gradient .text { color: #e2e8f0; } .slide-insight.style-gradient .insight-text { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #FFFFFF; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 85%; margin: 32px 0; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .slide-insight.style-gradient .step { color: #60a5fa; opacity: 0.25; } .slide-insight.style-gradient .brand { color: #60a5fa; } .slide-insight.style-gradient::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.2) 0%, transparent 70%); } .slide-insight.style-gradient::after { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(153, 15, 250, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%); }
